subject: en_read
source: English National Curriculum — English programmes of study: key stage 2 (Year 5), reading comprehension, DfE 2013

weeks.topic: Adventure fiction: predicting from details (Kensuke's Kingdom)
objectives: Predict what might happen from details stated and implied
Justify predictions with evidence
Check and revise predictions while reading

weeks.topic: Adventure fiction: characters' motives and feelings
objectives: Infer characters' feelings, thoughts and motives from their actions
Support inferences with evidence from the text
Discuss how characters change

weeks.topic: Greek myths: heroes, gods and themes
objectives: Read a range of Greek myths (e.g. Perseus, Theseus)
Identify common themes such as heroism and punishment
Compare heroes from different myths

weeks.topic: Legends: King Arthur and the conventions of legends
objectives: Identify the conventions of legends
Distinguish between historical fact and legend
Discuss the qualities of a legendary hero

weeks.topic: Non-chronological reports: retrieving and recording information
objectives: Retrieve, record and present information from non-fiction
Use headings and subheadings to locate information
Make notes in own words

weeks.topic: Articles: distinguishing fact and opinion
objectives: Distinguish between statements of fact and opinion
Identify words that signal opinion
Discuss why writers mix fact and opinion

weeks.topic: Narrative poetry: The Highwayman
objectives: Explore how language and rhythm tell a story in verse
Discuss the effect of repetition and imagery
Explain the poet's choices

weeks.topic: Poetry by heart: learning and performing a poem
objectives: Learn a poem by heart
Perform with intonation, tone and volume to make meaning clear
Discuss how performance changes meaning

weeks.topic: Stories from other cultures: Anansi tales
objectives: Read traditional stories from West African and Caribbean traditions
Identify the trickster character type
Compare with traditional tales from other cultures

weeks.topic: Historical fiction: setting in time (Goodnight Mister Tom)
objectives: Identify how authors show a historical setting
Infer how life was different in the past
Discuss themes of friendship and change

weeks.topic: Newspaper reports: structure and purpose
objectives: Identify how the structure of a news report supports its purpose
Retrieve the 5 Ws (who, what, where, when, why)
Compare reports of the same event

weeks.topic: Persuasive texts: how language persuades
objectives: Identify persuasive devices in adverts and letters
Explain how language affects the reader
Evaluate how convincing a text is

weeks.topic: Playscripts: reading aloud and conventions
objectives: Prepare playscripts to read aloud and perform
Identify stage directions and their purpose
Show understanding through intonation

weeks.topic: Classic fiction: The Secret Garden
objectives: Read an extract of a classic novel
Work out unfamiliar and old-fashioned vocabulary from context
Discuss how the setting changes the characters

weeks.topic: Term 1 review: retrieval, inference and genre
objectives: Revisit key reading skills from Term 1
Answer retrieval and inference questions
Compare genres read this term

weeks.topic: Science fiction: world-building (The Wild Robot)
objectives: Identify how authors build an imagined world
Discuss themes of nature and technology
Predict how the character will adapt

weeks.topic: Biography: lives of explorers
objectives: Read biographies of explorers
Summarise key events in a life
Distinguish fact from opinion in biographies

weeks.topic: Explanation texts: how presentation supports meaning
objectives: Identify how diagrams, captions and labels help meaning
Explain a process in own words
Retrieve information from text and images

weeks.topic: Mystery stories: clues and red herrings
objectives: Identify clues and red herrings
Make and justify inferences about the culprit
Discuss how the author withholds information

weeks.topic: Nature poetry: imagery and the senses
objectives: Explore how poets use imagery to describe nature
Identify sensory language
Compare two nature poems

weeks.topic: Fables and parables: identifying the moral
objectives: Identify the moral of fables and parables
Discuss themes and conventions across stories
Relate the message to real life

weeks.topic: Modern fiction: comparing characters (Wonder)
objectives: Compare characters' viewpoints in a modern novel
Discuss themes of kindness and difference
Support views with quotations

weeks.topic: Digital texts: skimming and scanning websites
objectives: Skim to get the gist of a web page
Scan for specific information
Evaluate how reliable an online source is

weeks.topic: Fantasy: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
objectives: Identify themes of good versus evil
Explore how a fantasy world is entered and described
Discuss how characters change through the story

weeks.topic: Diaries: first-person viewpoint and voice
objectives: Identify the features of diary writing
Infer the writer's feelings from their voice
Compare a fictional and a real diary

weeks.topic: Summarising a chapter in under 100 words
objectives: Summarise the main ideas drawn from more than one paragraph
Select key details and leave out minor ones
Write a summary in own words

weeks.topic: Mid-year assessment: reading comprehension
objectives: Answer retrieval, inference and vocabulary questions
Explain answers with evidence
Read fiction, non-fiction and poetry

weeks.topic: Recommending books: reviews and discussion
objectives: Recommend books to peers with reasons
Read and write book reviews
Take part in a book discussion

weeks.topic: Humorous fiction: how authors create humour (The BFG)
objectives: Identify how authors create humour through language
Explore invented words and wordplay
Discuss why readers find it funny

weeks.topic: Poetry: comparing poems on the same theme
objectives: Compare two poems on the same theme
Identify similarities and differences in language
Express a preference with reasons

weeks.topic: Discussion texts: arguments for and against
objectives: Identify arguments for and against an issue
Track how the writer balances views
Form a personal opinion with reasons

weeks.topic: Graphic novels: reading images and text together
objectives: Explore how images and text work together
Infer meaning from panels and expressions
Discuss the order of panels and pacing

weeks.topic: Traditional tales retold: comparing versions
objectives: Compare different versions of the same tale
Identify changes in setting, character and ending
Discuss why authors retell tales

weeks.topic: Environmental non-fiction: author's purpose and bias
objectives: Identify the author's purpose
Spot bias in environmental texts
Evaluate the evidence used

weeks.topic: Class novel book talk: justifying opinions with evidence
objectives: Discuss a class novel in depth
Justify opinions using evidence
Build on others' ideas in discussion

weeks.topic: End-of-year assessment: reading comprehension
objectives: Answer a range of comprehension questions
Use evidence to support answers
Read across genres

weeks.topic: Year 5 reading review and summer reading
objectives: Reflect on books read this year
Set reading goals for the summer
Choose books for Year 6
